newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan asks U.S. for more aviation talks in July.
newsitem.headline: Japan asks U.S. for more aviation talks in July.

text.p: Japan has asked the United States to hold another round of aviation talks in the second or third week of July in Tokyo, a Transport Ministry spokesman said on Tuesday.

He said the United States had responded to an earlier request for talks in June by suggesting June 26 or 27 as possible dates but the Transport Ministry felt the reply had come too late to make preparations and had asked for the talks to be held in July.
Washington had requested that the talks continue on an informal basis, which Japan was willing to agree to, the spokesman said.
U.S. and Japanese officials have been meeting irregularly this year to try to resolve problems in their current air pact and set the stage for talks on a more liberal accord.
